reasoning: This is a single-arm phase II trial with 32 patients receiving 5'-azacitidine post-transplant. Step 1 (TARGET ENGAGEMENT): No PK/PD data or biomarker evidence provided to confirm DNA methyltransferase inhibition, though azacitidine is a well-established DNMT inhibitor. Step 2 (PATHWAY MODULATION): No biomarker data showing DNA hypomethylation or epigenetic changes. Step 3 (CLINICAL TRANSLATION): Only 2/32 patients relapsed at 2 years, which appears low for high-risk post-transplant patients, but without a control group or historical comparison, efficacy cannot be definitively assessed. Step 4 (POPULATION EFFECTS): No subgroup analysis reported. Step 5 (CONFOUNDERS): Single-arm design prevents definitive efficacy assessment; safety signals including hemorrhages and infections are concerning but manageable with dose modifications.
